description:
Goal
One source callable construction owns one runtime object and producer-correlated member plan. Exact calls may use private ABIs; every indirect call consumes only the object's public ABI. Root packaging closes physical contracts so Native/interpreter never reconstruct them from positions, semantic types, or World.

First losses
1. Packaging flattened producer members and reused consumer-position identity.
2. Symbolic positions survived packaging while physical carrier/layout facts were omitted.
3. Direct-surface compatibility could erase settled first-class representation at input/capture projection.
4. Boundary return demand was rebuilt from semantic return type, widening ignored callbacks and filtering zero-width public boundaries.
5. CallEdge::Indirect dropped return flow. Native compensated with a hardcoded one-ValueRef adapter, while transport upgraded every closure ResumePayload to ValueRef even when its solved structure was Nothing.
6. Public wrapper return layout copied the first private member.
7. Runtime reachability treated free inference templates as concrete subjects.

Proven model
- CallableFlowFact owns one producer's function, captures, member resolutions, input mappings, direct/public uses, and consumer-owned result demand. Direct compatibility never clears first-class state.
- TransportLayout is one physical fact: structural shape plus carrier. Nothing cannot carry ValueRef.
- BackendValueLayout closes structural, carrier, tys, and reprs. BackendReturnLayout adds only divergence.
- Positions end at RootBackendProduct. Packaged return flow is Tail, Continue with source contract, or Deliver with source contract and entry. Indirect edges carry flow like direct/dispatch edges.
- ReturnPayload/ResumePayload constrain flow and then disappear.
- Public return is Diverges, Absent, or ValueRef from settled consumer demand across all members. Mixed absent/value members are invalid. Semantic return type and first-member private layout are not authorities.
- Distinct source constructions remain distinct objects when joined. They agree on public ABI; runtime FnId/code pointer owns indirect identity.
- Construction identity is allocation-only.
- Runtime reachability grounds free variables to Any while preserving known structure.

Spike proofs
- Construction instrumentation found zero call-time construction uses; fallback deletion preserves Enum/Range controls.
- ea1920945 seals routes and deletes endpoint catalogs/scans; focused gates and strict clippy pass.
- 568c80c30 proves closed public return; 4bc36c472 proves shared BackendValueLayout and deletes input/capture scans and caches.
- 4c7ba079b is the durable red opaque Enum.each ignored-result proof.
- f7208331f proves first-class singleton inputs cannot reuse direct-only shapes.
- b0822a1a1 preserves first-class capture state and deletes 139 lines of semantic-type return-demand reconstruction.
- a7c9844bc proves two branch refs remain two producer boundaries, both Absent, with one indirect consumer.
- Dynamic probing proved each_step ResumePayload is singleton, Ignore, unconsumed, structural Nothing, yet was assigned ValueRef solely by callsite kind.
- 5fbef9c96 is the green integrated solution spike: indirect flow retained, zero-width carrier absent, sealed source consumed, boxed adapter deleted. Stat 88 additions/153 deletions. Opaque interp/JIT, consumed opaque control, Range scalar/2, direct-only inventory, fmt/check/clippy pass.
- a95594f54 preserves the larger producer/member WIP but is not a landing candidate alone.

Test intent audit
- Keep semantic controls: Tail closed routes, direct-only callables absent from wrapper inventory, producer-correlated member ownership, allocation-only identity, indirect calls without private targets, equal sealed captures for concordant members, and actual interpreter/JIT resume behavior.
- Replace stale mechanics: semantic-type-derived public return shapes, per-surface public ABIs, exact boundary/capture counts, arbitrary first-wrapper selection, curried_add telemetry identity, and hand-built edge fixtures missing sealed return flow.
- Treat proven reductions as improvements: quicksort's reachable frontier falls from 21 to 17 and should be a <=17 bound plus required/cold membership and schedule-set equality; fixture 00181's exact inventory of 10 disappears in favor of packaged-set closure; captures leave return payload lanes; an unconsumed suspension may allocate less.
- Rebaseline the print-only suspension resource fixture downward without raw FnId identity, but retain a consumed continuation control that resumes in interpreter and JIT and observes captured state.
- Preserve real reds: direct surfaces must not erase first-class state; enum_take_drop_split must not box its direct-only predicate or panic natively; false no-matching-clause diagnostics must disappear; corpus maximum ascents stays <=4.
- Restore the unrelated reusable-cons alias-fallback coverage. Repair the weakened distinct-return-flow helper so it compares the sealed source layout with the caller return layout.
- Tests measure intent with behavior, set membership, monotone bounds, and closed authorities. They do not force deleted positions, endpoint catalogs, semantic return reconstruction, or private layouts back into the packaged model.

Landing strategy
Reconcile a95594f54, ea1920945, 568c80c30, 4bc36c472, f7208331f, b0822a1a1, and 5fbef9c96 into one final commit from integration. Prefer shared contracts and deletion. Remove call-time construction, packaged position lookups, endpoint catalogs, input scans/caches, duplicate layouts, blanket closure carrier rules, type-derived callable return demand, empty-return filtering, first-member public return selection, and the boxed one-lane adapter.

Tests assert production intent. Add no code comments.

Acceptance
- Prove producer ownership, allocation-only identity, monotone first-class carrier, consumer-owned Absent/ValueRef, indirect sealed flow, shared layouts, and no packaged symbolic ABI positions.
- Opaque ignored/consumed, Enum operator-ref/take/drop/split/search, Range scalar/2/3, multi_relay, resource, direct-only, and quicksort interp/JIT/build controls pass.
- Resource assertions accept proven decreases while rejecting increased work, storage, reachability, or diagnostic volume.
- cargo test --lib and strict all-target clippy pass except the three known raw-telemetry handler baselines owned by fz-1ah.12.
- Release fixture 00181 emits no diagnostics at about 0.05-0.06s; telemetry remains 1,114 records rather than about 3,200.

Known baseline
At pristine ca59b76ac exactly three library tests fail because handlers expect copied telemetry metadata: compiler2_notes_top_level_types_into_the_global_scope, compiler2_protocol_domain_marker_stays_type_owned_while_dispatch_revises_when_impls_land, and source_publication_defers_local_macro_expansion_until_function_demand. fz-1ah.12 owns them.
title: fz-k22: preserve producer callable constructions behind one public indirect ABI
